localValidation.note: Subsequent measurement changes are documents/JSON only, with identical code/configuration. Final PR CI is verified independently. A prior full check exposed a preexisting fixed-room-ID collision in privacy.test.ts; the DB-only fixture now uses its own namespace and cleanup without changing product deletion logic.

report.recordScope: Job summaries include common AI identities, model usage, evaluations and timing; per-candidate/PV output and authentication headers are omitted. Loopback HTTP, not public HTTPS or an actual VPS.

limitations: Local OrbStack Linux aarch64 with 2CPU/1GiB, no extra swap, 64 pids, init, non-root, no network and read-only code/model. No actual VPS, public HTTPS, x86_64, systemd or deployed rollback test.

One sample each for single/parallel CPU500ms and analysis30s on initial OFF/ON positions, plus one CPU after inference-process failure; health during analysis sampled 10 times. Not formal capacity, latency, or strength evidence.

queueMs is scheduler wait; restoreMs is native replay; searchMs excludes model wait; inferenceMs is model wait; computeMs includes IPC/finalization. Final GET wallMs is loopback response time. pollElapsedMs starts when polling begins, which is later than submission for the parallel analysis.
RSS sums HTTP/compute Bun and Python and double-counts shared pages; external smoke Bun excluded from RSS but included in cgroup hard limit. 100ms sampling is not an instantaneous allocation limit.
Smoke uses configurable trial overrides maxQueueAnalysis=1 and analysisRequests=2. Other defaults include 2 workers/1 CPU-reserved, RSS896MiB, CPU500ms/work32768, analysis30000ms/work1000000.

Job/usage state is memory-only, not a billing ledger. Request IDs bind a new UUID to the service monotonic minute window, and result/idempotency TTL>=120s prevents purged old IDs from re-executing. Fake-clock tests cover TTL/forced-kill decisions; Linux smoke covers live expiry/cancel/restart and SIGKILL of only the inference Python followed by replacement and actual model use.
Model is unchanged #190/#191 CPU functional checkpoint with no-sole-winner-only Value labels. Public CPU and probabilities unchanged; no strength/calibration inference.
Cold OS cache, max history/replay, prolonged/many-user load, actual OOM and abrupt parent SIGKILL remain unverified. T02/T03/T05 unresolved.
